sheets.prompt: Create an original transparent dialogue expression atlas for Nell, the young woman in the TOP LEFT cell of the supplied Poem portrait sheet. Use that one cell for character identity and painting style only. Ignore all other characters. Preserve short tousled near-black hair with long uneven fringe falling across one eye, amber eyes, fair skin, small ear ring, navy scarf, fitted dark leather courier outfit and antique gold scarf clasp, together with the same three-quarter view facing viewer’s right. Output a wide canvas with exactly three equal square cells in one horizontal row. Each cell contains a complete isolated chest-up portrait with matching scale, silhouette, costume, hairstyle, body pose, head position and torso crop.
